name: Sultanates of the Malay world
summary: The Muslim port sultanates of the Malay world, such as Demak, Ternate, Tidore and Banten, that controlled the spice trade before Dutch dominance.

knownFor.label: Cloves of Ternate
knownFor.note: The Maluku islands were the only source of cloves.

knownFor.label: Great Mosque of Demak
knownFor.note: One of the oldest mosques in Java.
